text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - Private Tunisian importers recently bought 48,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat, European grain traders said Monday. Prices were not disclosed and the sale involved three 16,000-tonne shipments. The European Union was likely to supply one cargo for May and the United States the others for second half June and second half July, one exporter said.

WHEAT TENDERS - Taiwan Flour Millers Association (TFMA) on Tuesday seeks 68,300 tonnes of U.S. wheat, U.S. exporters said. It seeks 34,000 tonnes for April 25-May 15 shipment (17,300 tonnes spring wheat, 11,600 tonnes hard red winter wheat and 5,100 tonnes white wheat) and 34,300 tonnes for May 15-June 5 shipment (18,300 tonnes spring wheat, 11,500 tonnes hard red winter and 4,500 tonnes white wheat).
- Jordan will tender for 120,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter and/or northern spring wheat on May 1 for May/June shipment.
WHEAT TENDERS - Taiwan will retender on April 23 for two shipments of U.S. wheat totalling 68,000 tonnes. Taiwan had passed on the tender on Tuesday due to high prices.
- Results were expected Tuesday on Iraq's tender on April 18 for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for June arrival.
- CCC seeks up to 7,220 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat, maximum moisture 13.5 percent, under the export program for Bosnia for May 7-31 shipment.
- Algeria seeks 100,000 tonnes of optional durum wheat for shipment in May and June.

OILSEED TENDER - South Korea will tender Tuesday for 53,500 tonnes of oilseeds, including 14,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal, 6,500 tonnes cottonseed meal, 8,000 tonnes of grain screening pellet and 25,000 tonnes of palm kernel meal.
SOYMEAL TENDER - El Salvador is to tender April 28 for 8,000 to 10,000 tonnes of PL-480 soybean meal for May 7-22 shipment, the buyer's agent said.

COMMODITY TENDER - The Commodity Credit Corp of USDA said it will tender April 29 for pinto beans, sunflower oil, bulgur and wheat-soy blend for donation to Moldova. It seeks 255 tonnes of pinto beans, 605 tonnes of sunflower oil, 510 tonnes of bulgur (a cracked wheat), and 255 tonnes of a wheat-soy blend. The beans, bulgur and wheat-soy blend were for June 6-20 shipment and the oil was for June 20-July 5.

MARKET TALK - The U.S. State Department said on Monday it would consider further food aid to famine-stricken North Korea if this were requested by the U.N. World Food Program... Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said Monday his department was trying to dissuade Congress from limiting the major U.S. export subsidy program to $10 million, down from $100 million...U.S. grain and soybeans inspected for export during the week ended April 17, according to USDA: soybeans 8.904 million bushels vs 12.087 million the previous week; wheat 15.912 million vs 23.316 million; corn 35.397 million vs 34.207 million; sorghum 5.228 million vs 5.700 million; oats and barley nil.
